props.name: config
props.description: One entry per series, keyed by the number column it reads. Each entry is a `ChartSeriesConfig` with a required `label` and `color` and an optional `format`, `icon`, `barVariant`, `stack`, `missing`, `projectedFrom`, `qualityKey` and `interval`. Write it `as const satisfies ChartConfig`, so a misspelt literal `qualityKey` fails the type. Series that share a `stack` id stack in one column. A series `interval` coarser than Root's, such as hourly usage under quarter-hour prices, draws each value across the Root slots of its own slot, and the option, the tooltip and the table name that slot. Fuse never sums or averages. A `color` is a role, a list of two or more roles, a scale or a threshold. A role list is a decorative gradient that never follows the value. A scale, "chart-seq" or "chart-diverging", bins each value into 7 steps, and the diverging scale centres them on 0, so a negative value takes a mirrored step below the solid zero line. A bar paints its step, and a Line or Area paints a gradient along the value axis. A threshold, `{ threshold, below, above }`, paints `above` on values above `threshold` and `below` on values at or below it, and the legend lists both sides. A line and its fill change colour where they cross the threshold, and a bar, the active dot, the markers and the tooltip swatch paint their own side. The tooltip, the table and spoken text keep the series' own label. Fuse computes no threshold, so pass the same number to a `ReferenceLine` to show it. A stacked Line or Area, or one under `stackOffset="expand"`, throws `scale-colour-on-stack` for a scale or a threshold. Set `--chart-color-<key>` on Root for a colour outside the roles.

props.name: data
props.description: The rows, one per slot or category. Every cell is serialisable, so a server component passes it. The plot keeps its height and draws no mark until the browser measures it, and a loading icon fades in at its middle if that takes more than a moment.

props.name: data-fade

props.name: data-intro
props.description: The entrance wipe origin, physical under `dir="rtl"` too. "none" turns the entrance off. The entrance plays once, the first time a third of the plot's height is in view, or half the height of the viewport or of the scroll container that clips a taller plot, whether the chart hydrated server HTML or mounted in the browser. Until then Root writes `data-entrance="waiting"` and the marks wait at the entrance's first frame: bars at their base, and lines, areas and dots clipped from the origin. The axes, the legend, the table and the chart's name render at once. Root writes `data-entrance="played"` as the entrance starts, and drops it once the wipe of lines, areas and dots has run or is cut short, or at once when no line, area or dots wipe in. Scrolling away and back, hiding the chart and showing it again, even mid-wipe, or a new origin never replays it, and a line or an area added later never wipes in. A data update while the entrance waits plays it with the latest data. Reduced motion, "none" and printing draw the marks at rest at once. A Bar behind its own Suspense boundary that arrives while the entrance waits grows with the rest, and one that arrives after the entrance started draws at rest. A bar that a data update adds after the entrance writes `data-intro="fade"` on itself and fades in. A bar that an `xRange` change, a brush step or a pan adds writes `data-intro="none"` and takes its place at once.

props.name: defaultActiveX

ArrowDown and ArrowUp move the series focus. Enter and Space select the focused series while a `LegendToggleGroup` is mounted, and pin the tooltip otherwise.
